description: This file defines a simulated in-memory database for managing users and games in a Tic Tac Toe application. It includes methods for creating users, managing games, and storing game history.

classes.name: Database
classes.description: A class that simulates a database for storing users and game information with methods for creating and retrieving user and game data.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the Database class, setting up in-memory dictionaries for users, games, and game history.

methods.name: dict create_user(self, username: str, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user, hashes their password, and stores the user information in the database.

methods.name: Optional[dict] get_user(self, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their user ID.

methods.name: Optional[dict] get_user_by_email(self, email: str)
methods.description: Finds and returns a user by their email address.

methods.name: Optional[dict] verify_password(self, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Verifies a user's password against the stored hashed password.

methods.name: dict create_game(self, player_x_id: int, player_o_id: int)
methods.description: Creates a new game instance, setting up the initial game state and storing it in the database.

methods.name: Optional[dict] get_game(self, game_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a game by its game ID.

methods.name: Optional[dict] update_game(self, game_id: int, game_state: dict)
methods.description: Updates the state of an existing game in the database.

methods.name: dict create_game_history(self, game_id: int, winner_id: Optional[int], is_draw: bool)
methods.description: Records the history of a game, including the winner and whether it ended in a draw.

methods.name: List[dict] get_user_game_history(self, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves the history of games for a specific user.

ctags.pattern: /^    def create_game(self, player_x_id: int, player_o_id: int) -> dict:$/

ctags.pattern: /^    def create_game_history(self, game_id: int, winner_id: Optional[int], is_draw: bool) -> dict/
ctags.signature: (self, game_id: int, winner_id: Optional[int], is_draw: bool)

ctags.pattern: /^    def create_user(self, username: str, email: str, password: str) -> dict:$/
ctags.signature: (self, username: str, email: str, password: str)

ctags.pattern: /^    def update_game(self, game_id: int, game_state: dict) -> Optional[dict]:$/

ctags.pattern: /^    def verify_password(self, email: str, password: str) -> Optional[dict]:$/
